headline: From Refuge to Ranger: Woman Leads Anti-Poaching Unit in Zimbabwe
meta_description: After escaping domestic violence, a Zimbabwean woman was selected for an all-female anti-poaching unit and rose to lead patrols.
summary_short: A Zimbabwean mother rebuilt her life after leaving a violent marriage, becoming one of 16 women chosen for an elite anti-poaching patrol unit.
body:
A Zimbabwean woman escaping a violent marriage with her young daughter found a new purpose as part of an all-female anti-poaching unit. She was one of only 16 women selected from nearly 100 applicants—a competitive process that recognized both her determination and capability.

Her journey represents more than personal survival. By earning a role within the unit and rising to lead patrols, she has become part of a conservation effort that protects Zimbabwe's wildlife while creating meaningful employment for women rebuilding their lives. Her ascent from applicant to patrol leader demonstrates that second chances, paired with opportunity and resilience, can transform not just individual stories but contribute to broader community and environmental impact.
